summary: Independent exact-head review of #128 is NO-GO: migration completeness is self-derived, the resolved migration digest is ignored, interrupted Docker creation can leak resources, and OpenAPI parity can skip runtime source/errors.
validation: Exact-head QA passed local and Docker checks but confirmed hosted/final-image evidence is still pending
blockers: Smoke derives expected migrations from supplied files, so stale root/chart bundles can agree and pass.
Release resolves a migration image digest but final smoke runs a mutable/default database image instead.
SIGTERM during Docker network/container creation can occur before IDs are captured, defeating cleanup.
OpenAPI route parity recognizes only a narrow literal form and silently skips missing runtime source.
next_action: Return to code for authoritative migration manifest, migration-image digest wiring, label-based interrupted-create cleanup, and fail-closed complete route parity; then repeat review and hosted QA.
